The Twin Sailors are a pair of jolly tars. They are experienced individuals who have seen everything in the world.

## History

The Twin Sailors were imaginary figures created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in his stories about his rock friends at the shore. The oldest Twin Sailor took [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) on a magical voyage to the sunset within one of Paul's tales. Paul's written composition detailing these fictional companions was later sent by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) in a letter.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The Twin Sailors are imaginary rock figures created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), who envisions them coming ashore to talk with him. In a school composition, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) details a magical voyage to the sunset with the oldest of the Twin Sailors, though he clarifies in a postscript that the story is not actually true.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), +5 more_
